title: check.sh --json (contract 1)
description: Environment check of the plugin. Check order is stable; new check ids may appear and consumers ignore the ones they do not know. See core/contract/contract.md.

ok.description: true when no check with required=true has a status other than ok.

id.description: Known ids: jq, git, os, shell, agent-cli, agent-auth, plugin, plugin-current. Others may appear; consumers ignore the ones they do not know.

status.description: ok; missing (not there); warning (there, with a caveat); unknown (cannot be known here, never an error).

detail.description: Text for people; on missing/warning it says how to fix it. Not meant to be parsed.
